title: Le Creuset Cast Iron Oval Dutch Oven – Blue – Made in France – Enameled Casserole Pot
description:
Beautiful Le Creuset oval cast iron Dutch oven in a classic blue enamel finish. Made in France, this high-quality cookware is known for its excellent heat retention and even cooking performance.
The oval shape is ideal for roasting meats, poultry, casseroles, stews, and slow-cooked dishes. The heavy enameled cast iron distributes heat evenly and works perfectly on the stovetop or in the oven.
Details:
• Brand: Le Creuset
• Type: Oval Dutch oven / casserole
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Color: Blue exterior with light enamel interior
• Made in France
• Oval shape with two side handles and matching lid
• Approx. width (handle to handle): about 30 cm
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use. The enamel interior remains clean and well maintained. Please see photos for details.
A beautiful piece of classic French cookware, perfect for everyday cooking or for collectors of Le Creuset cast iron.
